# Excalidraw

This layer of the Excalidraw monorepo is dedicated to the color picker feature, providing components and utilities for selecting and managing colors within the application.

## Overview

The Excalidraw color picker layer includes input fields, picker panels, and lists of colors, enabling users to choose and apply colors to their drawings.

## Responsibilities

- **Input Fields**: Manages the user input for color selection.
- **Picker Panels**: Displays the color picker interface.
- **Color Lists**: Provides a list of predefined colors for quick selection.

## How it works

The `ColorPickerPanel` component renders the picker interface, displaying the available colors and allowing the user to interact with them.

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `PKG_NAME`, `PKG_VERSION`, `PROD`, `VITE_APP_ENABLE_TRACKING`, `VITE_APP_LIBRARY_BACKEND`, `VITE_APP_LIBRARY_URL`, `VITE_APP_PLUS_LP`, `VITE_WORKER_ID`.
- Configuration files: `packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json`, `packages/excalidraw/locales/percentages.json`, `packages/excalidraw/package.json`, `packages/excalidraw/tsconfig.json`, `packages/tsconfig.base.json`.

## Related layers

- [Project README](../../README.md): the overview of the whole project and every layer.
- [Packages](../packages.md): This folder contains various utility and helper functions used throughout the Excalidraw application, including analytics tracking, drawing trails, clipboard operations, and more.
- [Excalidraw Common](excalidraw-common.md): This folder contains common utility functions and utilities for debugging.
- [Excalidraw Common Tests](excalidraw-common-tests.md): Contains test files for various common utilities and data structures.
- [Excalidraw Element](excalidraw-element.md): This folder contains various classes and functions related to elements and their interactions within the Excalidraw application.
- [Excalidraw Element Tests](excalidraw-element-tests.md): These tests cover various aspects of the Excalidraw element library, including creating and selecting rectangles, bounding calculations, collision detection, cropping elements, and more.
- [Excalidraw Tests](excalidraw-tests.md): Contains test files for various components and functionalities of the Excalidraw application, using React, Vitest, and other libraries.
- [Excalidraw Fractional Indexing](excalidraw-fractional-indexing.md): This folder contains the source code for fractional indexing, including utilities for generating and validating keys.
- [Excalidraw Laser Pointer](excalidraw-laser-pointer.md): This folder contains the source code for a laser pointer application, including classes and functions for managing laser pointer settings and calculations.
- [Excalidraw Math](excalidraw-math.md): This folder contains various mathematical functions and utilities for geometric calculations, including angle, curve, ellipse, line, PCA, point, polygon, and range operations.
- [Excalidraw Math Tests](excalidraw-math-tests.md): Contains test files for mathematical operations and calculations.
- [Excalidraw Utilities](excalidraw-utilities.md): This folder contains utility functions and classes used for exporting and manipulating shapes in the software project.
- [Excalidraw Utilities Tests](excalidraw-utilities-tests.md): Contains test files for various utility functions and components in the project.
